items:
30A Seacrest Knights is nestled between Rosemary and Alys Beach and boasts a gorgeous resort style pool and within walking distance or quick free tram to the beach!

📍 Located in Seacrest Beach
🏡 Keyless entry to the open-concept kitchen/dining area
🏊 Amenity Passes: Enjoy the 12,000 sq ft lagoon resort pool with an onsite café, just a 3-minute walk from home.
🏖️ Private Beach Access: Free tram service for guests or very short walk!
🔥 Outdoor Grill: Perfect for family barbecues.
🎲 Games Galore: Indoor and outdoor games for the whole family.
🍳 Fully Stocked Kitchen: Includes an air fryer, blender, mixer, toaster, and kids' plates/cups.
🛌 5 bedrooms: 3 kings, 1 full with twin trundle, bunk room with 4 full size bunks
📺 Entertainment: Smart TVs with cable in the living room and all bedrooms.
💻 High-Speed Wi-Fi: Stay connected effortlessly.
🍼 For Little Ones: Pack and Play and crib (bring your own sheets).
☕ Coffee Lovers Rejoice: Keurig and filtered coffee options.
🏖️ Beach Essentials: Beach toys, chairs, and towels provided.


WHAT'S NEARBY
Property is located in Seacrest Beach and has a private beach access. You're within walking distance of Alys and Rosemary Beach and can enjoy the amenities of all 3 communities (restaurants, shops and recreational outfitters that rent bikes or paddle boards)

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS FIRST FLOOR:

- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub, Direct Balcony Access
- Guest Bedroom: Four Full Beds, Bathroom with Shower Only

SECOND FLOOR:

- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower, Crib


THIRD FLOOR:

- Guest Bedroom: Full size and Twin Bed w/ shared bathroom with shower
- Guest Bedroom: King bed w/ shared bathroom with shower, Private Rooftop Balcony

THINGS TO KNOW
3 parking spots in front of home with up to 2 more in adjacent lot
Onsite 24/7 Security
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
